skills.name: Find common denominator
skills.definition: Find a common denominator for unlike fractional parts and convert fractions to equivalent forms before subtraction.

skills.name: Subtract same-denominator fractions
skills.definition: Subtract fractional parts with a common denominator by subtracting numerators and retaining the denominator, including cases involving zero fractional parts.

skills.name: Work with whole and mixed-number parts
skills.definition: Represent whole numbers, fractions, and mixed numbers as whole-plus-fraction parts, subtract whole-number parts, and recombine the result.

skills.name: Borrow for fractional subtraction
skills.definition: Regroup one or more whole units into fractional units when the minuend fractional part is too small to subtract the subtrahend fractional part.

skills.name: Simplify final result
skills.definition: Reduce non-lowest-term fractional results and standardize answers by removing zero fractional parts when appropriate.

skills.name: Find common denominator
skills.definition: Find a common denominator and convert fractions or fractional parts to equivalent fractions when denominators differ.

skills.name: Subtract like fractions
skills.definition: Subtract same-denominator fractions by subtracting numerators and keeping the denominator, including cases with a zero numerator.

skills.name: Separate and recombine mixed parts
skills.definition: Decompose quantities with whole-number components into whole and fractional parts, subtract or carry whole parts while treating missing parts as zero, and recombine the result.

skills.name: Borrow across whole and fraction
skills.definition: Regroup one or more whole units as d/d into the fractional part when the fractional subtraction would be negative.

skills.name: Simplify fraction
skills.definition: Reduce a nonzero fractional result to lowest terms by dividing numerator and denominator by a common factor.

skills.name: Find and use a common denominator
skills.definition: Find a common denominator for unlike fractions and convert the fraction parts to equivalent fractions with that denominator.

skills.name: Directly subtract common-denominator fractions
skills.definition: Subtract fractions with a common denominator by subtracting numerators when no regrouping or borrowing is needed.

skills.name: Subtract whole-number parts without regrouping
skills.definition: For mixed-number or whole-number subtraction with no borrowing, separate whole and fractional parts, subtract the whole-number parts, and recombine the result.

skills.name: Borrow whole units for fractional subtraction
skills.definition: When the fractional part of the minuend is too small, borrow one or more whole units, convert them into fractional units, adjust the whole part, and complete the subtraction.

skills.name: Simplify or normalize the final result
skills.definition: Express the final answer in an acceptable simplified form, including reducing fractions and removing zero whole or fractional parts.

skills.name: Subtract common-denominator fractions
skills.definition: Subtract fractions with a common denominator by subtracting numerators and keeping the denominator, including after conversion or regrouping.

skills.name: Find LCD and convert fractions
skills.definition: Find a least common denominator for unlike denominators and rewrite fractions as equivalent fractions with that denominator.

skills.name: Work with mixed and whole numbers
skills.definition: Represent mixed numbers and whole numbers as whole-plus-fraction quantities, subtract whole parts separately, and recombine whole and fractional results.

skills.name: Borrow from whole part
skills.definition: Regroup one or more whole units into denominator-sized fractional units when the fractional subtraction would otherwise be negative.

skills.name: Simplify final result
skills.definition: Reduce fractional results to lowest terms and express zero fractional parts as integer or whole-number results when appropriate.

skills.name: Find and use a common denominator
skills.definition: Find an LCD and rewrite fraction parts as equivalent fractions with that common denominator when denominators differ.

skills.name: Subtract same-denominator fractions
skills.definition: Subtract fractional quantities that already share a denominator by subtracting numerators and keeping the denominator, including recognizing a zero fractional result.

skills.name: Work with mixed and whole-number parts
skills.definition: Decompose whole or mixed-number operands into whole and fractional components, treat missing components as zero, subtract whole parts, and recombine the result.

skills.name: Borrow from the whole part
skills.definition: Regroup by borrowing one or more wholes into denominator-sized fractional units when the minuend's fractional part is smaller than the subtrahend's fractional part.

skills.name: Reduce fractional result
skills.definition: Simplify a nonzero fractional result to lowest terms by dividing numerator and denominator by a common factor.
